verseText: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations.
meaning: God will never forget or fail to keep the covenants (super special promises) he makes to his people.

recall.question: A covenant is a serious promise or agreement. How long does God remember His covenant?

meaning.question: What does it mean that God “remembers His covenant”?
choices: He will do what He promised to do
He forgets what He has promised to us

application.prompt: People sometimes forget what they promised, but God never does. People also break their promises, but God will always keep His own. Think of a promise God has made in the Bible and be encouraged that God will certainly keep it!
